title: Niello command invocation
description: Envelope for invoking a command on the Niello command bus (PLAN.md 5.1). The same envelope is used by the UI, the MCP server and ACP tool calls.

command.description: Dotted lowercase command id, e.g. niello.file.open.

input.description: Command input; must validate against the command's input_schema.

invocationId.description: Optional caller-chosen id echoed in the result and the audit log.
